name: pasta piperade
instructions:
The blended vegetable-tomato pasta sauce: sauté everything, blend smooth, toss with pasta.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- shallot (over onion — see the color note)
- garlic
- green bell pepper
- carrot
- tomato
- tomato paste (needed IN ADDITION to the tomato — see notes)
- white wine
- miso paste
- oregano
- red chili flakes
- butter + olive oil mix (the sauté fat)
- salt and black pepper

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. SAUTÉ everything in the butter + olive oil mix.
2. ALL GOES IN THE BLENDER — blend smooth.
3. Toss with SPAGHETTI, PENNE, or GNOCCHI.
4. Top with PARMESAN or GRUYERE. LEMON JUICE to brighten if the cheese is too strong.
notes:
=== UNRETIRED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

Retired with the rest of the tomato-sauce family, then brought back: I just find myself MAKING IT A LOT — which means it should stay.

=== TOMATO PASTE + TOMATO, BOTH — UNLIKE RATATOUILLE ===

Unlike [[ratatouille]], this needs TOMATO PASTE in addition to the tomato. The blend thins the fresh tomato out; the paste holds the backbone.

=== SHALLOT OVER ONION — THE COLOR RULE ===

Shallot over onion so the sauce RETAINS ITS RED/ORANGE COLOR better. (Same color-consciousness as the old mossy-green bouillon lesson — blended sauces show their inputs.)

=== WHITE WINE + MISO — THE FUNK, NECESSARY ===

White wine and miso paste are NECESSARY for funk — and they're better in THIN SAUCES like this one, where they don't taste like stew. (The silent-ingredient discipline applies to the miso as always.)

=== HERBS — OREGANO; THYME UNORIGINAL; ROSEMARY NO ===

OREGANO is the herb. THYME makes it taste UNORIGINAL; ROSEMARY wouldn't work at all (nothing here for it to grip — consistent with the mushroomed-lentils rosemary rule).

=== SMOOTH — NO SEEDS OR NUTS ===

Seeds and nuts are clashing across the board — this sauce should be SMOOTH; anything that leaves grit or body in the blend is wrong.

=== CREAM IS CLASHING ===

No cream — it causes you to LOSE THE INTRICATE FLAVOR OF THE CARROT/BELL PEPPER and pushes it into a more generic creamy tomato sauce. The vegetable intricacy is the point of the blend; cream flattens it.

=== LEMON JUICE — THE CHEESE CORRECTION ===

Lemon juice brightens the sauce if the cheese reads too strong. Correction move, not structural.

=== WANT TO TRY ===

- VODKA instead of the white wine (the vodka-sauce logic pointed at this thinner chassis).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[ratatouille]]: the same vegetable family unblended — and no tomato paste there.
- [[marcella-gnocchi-sauce]]: the surviving minimal tomato sauce; this is the maximal-blend end.
- [[weeknight-vegetarian-ragu]]: the chunky weeknight cousin.
